source: Copied by hand from the frozen rules in the main checkout (read only) on 2026-11-17; each entry cites file:line. The list of tests is section 3.3 of nba_project_reference.md (lines 131-144). No outcome of any test is here or anywhere on this route.
note: Scheduled reads and minimum n are the rules' own words, shortened. A test's result is published only at its look, by the project, not by this app.
